verdict: No mathematical error found in priority interpolation certificates or section counts. All seven saved minor determinants independently matched. Finite-to-general transfer is valid with the stated scope restrictions.

findings.finding: Independently reconstructed integer derivative matrices from the stored points, monomials and derivative labels, then used full Gauss-Jordan elimination to recompute the selected minors. For multiplicities1,2,3 and degrees3,6,9, nonzero determinants mod1009 are6,984,183, respectively; full column ranks are10,28,55.
findings.deduction: Each determinant is an integer not divisible by1009, hence nonzero in characteristic zero. Therefore the rational/complex matrix has full column rank. Its entries are polynomial in point coordinates; the same minor is nonzero on a nonempty Zariski-open set of ten-point configurations, giving the same nonexistence for general and hence very general points.
findings.scope: Only the tested multiplicities and degrees, including lower degrees by inclusion, are established. This is not an argument for all multiplicities.

findings.finding: Full-row-rank cases have selected determinants571,162,733 mod1009 and characteristic-zero kernel dimensions3,1,1. The special conic case has a nonzero5x5 minor (1005 mod1009), and the exact nonzero kernel vector for(y-2x)^2 annihilates the entire integer matrix.
findings.deduction: The full-row-rank bounds transfer to characteristic zero and general configurations by openness. In the conic example, the exact kernel witness supplies rank<=5 and the minor supplies rank>=5, so rank exactly5 over characteristic zero. For arbitrary distinct pairs, the doubled line gives the analogous geometric witness.
findings.scope: Distinguish vector-space kernel dimensions from projective linear-system dimensions (one less when nonempty); no claim that modular rank deficiency by itself proves characteristic-zero rank deficiency.

findings.finding: For genus2 C, h0(K_C)=2 and h0(mK_C)=2m-1 for m>=2 by Riemann-Roch and vanishing of sections of (1-m)K_C. Elliptic factors have trivial canonical bundles with one section. Kunneth gives1 at m=0,4 at m=1, and(2m-1)^2 thereafter.
findings.deduction: K_X is the pullback of K_(C×C), which is globally generated and nef; its square is nonzero while its cube vanishes, so numerical dimension2. The section growth has degree2.
findings.scope: This is a smooth explicit product example in which semiampleness is already supplied by the product structure. Section counts alone do not imply abundance for arbitrary varieties.

findings.finding: Available outputs correctly qualify two-precision volume computations as non-certified numerical agreement (#62), the Chern tensor as formal necessary constraints without realization (#76), and real scalar descent as distinct from geometric flips (#71). No obvious unrestricted-conjecture claim found in the available data.
